snippet.title: Born Again 2.0 | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hack-n-slash your way through the evil brewing in the Outer Realm! Stop the ominous Overlords in their tracks, but tread lightly, for around every corner holds a monster in waiting!

Born Again is a free-to-play, permadeath, hack-n-slash MMO available on iOS, Android, and Steam!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332210/Born_Again/
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/born-again-online/id1629507405
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.unnamedstudios.bornagain
Discord: https://discord.gg/DPjHHTFZDs
